scope: Environment of the September 29 agent 128K profile runs in this directory (agent-131k.json.gz, agent-8k.json.gz).

runtime_image.build_inputs: docker/Dockerfile, runtime/, configs/ and scripts/serve-container.sh are byte-identical between the benchmarked build and tag v0.4.0 for the files the image uses.
runtime_image.published_image: See the v0.4.0 release notes and docs/reproduce.md for the GHCR digest. The published image is rebuilt from tag v0.4.0 by .github/workflows/publish-image.yml.

model.draft: runtime/mtp-int4-g32 inside the model directory (compact INT4 MTP draft)

launch.how: configs/2x3090-128gb.env with configs/agent-128k.env appended, served with scripts/docker_serve.sh (make serve).

effective_profile_env.JIT_CACHE_DIR: persistent host directory mounted at /root/.humming and /root/.triton

launch.docker_run: docker run --rm --name qwen38-flash-next --gpus all --ipc host --cap-add SYS_PTRACE --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864 -p 127.0.0.1:18088:18088 -e <profile env> -v <jit-cache>/humming:/root/.humming -v <jit-cache>/triton:/root/.triton -v <model dir>:/model:ro <image> /model
startup_log_checks: Triton skinny GEMM enabled for 533 modules
Stream staging: borrowed hot pages of layers [40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47] as two slots

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 cores / 64 threads, 1 socket, 1 NUMA node
host.memory: 128 GB: 8 x 16 GB DDR4-3200 (8 channels populated)
host.swap: 8 GiB swap file permanently; the benchmark guard adds a temporary 56 GiB swap file for model loading and removes it afterwards
host.gpus: 2 x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 24 GB (no NVLink)
host.nvidia_driver: 595.84, NVIDIA open GPU kernel modules built locally with a PCIe peer-to-peer patch ported from aikitoria/open-gpu-kernel-modules (branch 595.71.05-p2p); user-space driver 595.84
host.pcie: both GPUs PCIe 4.0 x16; nvidia-smi topo -m reports PHB between the GPUs
host.p2p: nvidia-smi topo -p2p r and -p2p w report OK in both directions; custom all-reduce enabled (DISABLE_CUSTOM_ALL_REDUCE=0). Stock GeForce drivers do not expose PCIe P2P on RTX 3090; without it, keep DISABLE_CUSTOM_ALL_REDUCE=1 (about 2.5 ms slower per decode cycle).
host.host_conditions: other GPU and memory-heavy jobs stopped; runs start after 'PLE prefault complete'; persistent Humming/Triton JIT caches already populated
